content.name: Eyes of Charming
entries: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. They have 3 charges. While wearing them, you can expend 1 charge as an action to cast the {@spell charm person} spell (save {@dc 13}) on a humanoid within 30 feet of you, provided that you and the target can see each other. The lenses regain all expended charges daily at dawn.

content.name: Eyes of Charming
entries: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. They have 3 charges. While wearing them, you can expend 1 or more charges to cast {@spell Charm Person|SRD52} (save {@dc 13}). For 1 charge, you cast the level 1 version of the spell. You increase the spell's level by one for each additional charge you expend. The lenses regain all expended charges daily at dawn.
